AniLife native liquid-glass mobile player preview — static neutral frosted controls over existing Media3 + Morphe
Source feature commit 7afd7e85e76b13a9212cd9dc4269ddefe967c36e
Reference: b4-behroz/Liquid-Glass-UI-Video-Player design inspiration, with independent native Kotlin/Compose implementation (no third-party code copied; reference repository does not declare a license).
Changes: lightweight PlayerLiquidGlass modifier with cached neutral reflection shader; glass play/pause, transport buttons, action dock, timeline timestamp pills, back button, action labels. Seek thumb gains high-contrast glass rim while pointer-to-seek mapping, audio/video player, subtitle rendering and skip markers are untouched. Settings bottom sheet and side panel get neutral static reflections with no video blur or decoder impact.
CRITICAL: Do not change Media3 PlayerView/SurfaceView, NativeVideoAmbientSampler, videoAmbientWash, MorpheAmbientRenderer, sampling interval or temporal rendering. Keep all mobile features and original Morphe GPLv3 attribution.
Verify mobile unit tests, lint, assembleMobileDebug, apk signature. Publish exactly one universal APK only after success; stable release untouched; real-device testing still needed.
